beats.text: Your fast chip sits still for half the time just to wait for bits. Why does your tech stall on such basic math tasks?
beats.visual_focus: A glowing H100 chip pulsing red in the center with a stalled data stream.

beats.text: It is like a chef in a huge kitchen. They must walk for miles just to grab one single spoon for the soup they cook.
